title: Reflect Points Across Axes
objective: I can reflect points across the x-axis and y-axis on the coordinate plane.
model: coordinate plane with each axis as a mirror line: reflecting over the x-axis changes the sign of y, over the y-axis the sign of x

widgets.component: warm-up: quadrant of (−4, 5), point on the y-axis, the origin, quadrant for −x, −y
widgets.root: Identical to the lesson's warm-up (7-5/7-8 review); keys Quadrant II, (0, 3), (0, 0), Quadrant III verified.

widgets.component: (4, −3) over the x-axis, (−2, 6) over the y-axis, point on the y-axis, six reflection matches, 'change y when reflecting over the y-axis' error
widgets.root: Keys (4, 3), (2, 6) and all six match pairs recomputed; the error's wrong step is e=1 (changing the y-coordinate).

widgets.component: reflect six points over the stated axis, rule-to-description match, two-step reflection of (−3, 5), 'flip the x for an x-axis reflection' error
widgets.root: Table (3, 7), (5, 2), (8, 1), (4, −6), (0, −9), (3, 0) and A'' = (3, −5) recomputed; points on an axis map to themselves correctly.

widgets.component: generated: pick the reflected point from a drawn plane, coordinates of the mirror image, point on an axis, triangle vertex image
widgets.root: Ran 250 seeds x 4 levels: in every drawn four-choice figure the keyed label is the true reflection of P across the named axis, it is the only choice at those coordinates, and no point is outside the frame; wrong choices are the other-axis, swapped and both-sign images.

widgets.where: Practice 4.7; Challenge 3.1-3.2 (act:plot mode reflect L2, L3, L4)
widgets.component: plot the image A' (and A'' at L4) of a drawn point across a named axis
widgets.root: Real manipulable model: grid is the full plane, half-unit points from L3, L4 chains two axes; wrong-axis, original-point, both-signs, swapped x/y and same-axis-twice answers are named.

widgets.component: (3, 2) over each axis, which coordinate changes, (−5, 2) over the y-axis, pair that is a reflection over the x-axis, point that is its own y-axis reflection
widgets.root: Keys (−3, 2), (3, −2), 'only the x-coordinate', (5, 2), (3, 8)/(3, −8), (0, −4) verified. 'The ship' in 5.1-5.2 is introduced by the lesson's Connect scenario, but both stems give the point so they stand alone.

widgets.component: generated image coordinates, point on an axis, distance between a point and its image
widgets.root: Same generator checks as §4; (−6, 0) over the x-axis stays (−6, 0), (1, 6) over the y-axis is 2 apart, (−9, −10) is 18 apart.

widgets.component: error analysis; reflect triangle ABC over the y-axis; two reflected holes on a drawn panel; tile copy 4 units apart; laser log table; undo x-axis then y-axis
widgets.root: Table cells 7, 5, 3, −3, 0, 0, −8 and start point (−6, 9) recomputed; A and D (−5, 2) and (5, 2) are the y-axis mirror pair on the drawn panel; tile gap 2 + 2 = 4.

widgets.component: sort six points against P(4, 3); three error analyses; Noor/Mateo/Lin on (5, 0); Quadrant II over the x-axis; top edge of an image; triangle vertices; 14 apart; kite symmetry
widgets.root: Sort bins (the swap (3, 4) and (−3, 4), (4, 7) are not reflections) and error steps (e=1, 1, 2) verified; top edge y = −2, J'(−2, 1), K'(−6, 1), L'(−2, 5), (7, 3) and 'symmetric across the y-axis only' for the kite are right.

formulaOrder.formula: reflect over the x-axis: (x, y) → (x, −y); over the y-axis: (x, y) → (−x, y)

typography: Practice 2.1-2.5, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 5.4 and Challenge 2.1, 2.2 print coordinates with an ASCII hyphen-minus ((4, -3), (-2, 6), (-3, 5)); Practice 3.3's stem and Challenge 2.2's frame write A', A'' with ASCII apostrophes where the generator and Challenge 5.3 print J′, K′, A′, A″.
